description: This file is a PHP class for the admin marketplace cron controller in an OpenCart project. It manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling, disabling, and running cron jobs via web endpoints.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketplace\Cron
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace cron jobs in the OpenCart admin area, handling listing, running, enabling/disabling, and deletion of cron entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the cron management page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of cron jobs as a view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of cron jobs, preparing data for the cron list view.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a specific cron job based on cron_id, using store instance creation and controller invocation.
